breakdowns.header: Ingest Meter Data from EKM API
breakdowns.description: Extracts specified data fields from the EKM omnimeter pulse v.4 (meter number 300016966) via the EKM API push 3 and imports them into the cloud system every 1 minute.
conditions: Data fields to extract: meter name, meter data, meter day of week, reading date, model, address, firmware, total watt hour, voltage, amps, total power (watts), CT ratio, frequency (hz)
Data must be pulled from the EKM omnimeter every 1 minute

breakdowns.description: Applies SHA-256 hashing to the incoming meter data in the cloud system using a cryptographic private key.
conditions: Hashing must use a cryptographic private key
